With hard kill and no wait, node3 is most likely still seen alive, so the batchlog write succeeds (node2) and the CL=THREE data write times out with 2 responses (~35s runtime fits). If node3 were already detected dead, mutate_prepare would raise Unavailable(alive=2) before the batchlog write (storage_proxy.cc:4563-4564) and the test would still pass.
